typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		RFCodeTag as string,
		CreationDate as timestamp,
		MaterialID as integer,
		SiteName as string,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName as string,
		WFGrid as string,
		SiteGroup as string,
		MaterialType as string,
		LabPowerWatts as double,
		DataHall as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		Manufacturer as string,
		MaterialName as string,
		RecordStatus as string,
		UploadDate as date,
		RUSize as double,
		RackNlyteID as integer,
		OperationalStatus as string,
		LowerCabinetU as integer,
		AssetName as string,
		SerialNumber as string,
		RackName as string,
		NlyteID as integer,
		Model as string,
		MaterialSubtype as string,
		Tag as string,
		LastUpdateDate as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		RFCodeTag as string,
		CreationDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MaterialID as integer,
		SiteName as string,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName as string,
		WFGrid as string,
		SiteGroup as string,
		MaterialType as string,
		LabPowerWatts as double,
		DataHall as string,
		ETLUser as string,
		Manufacturer as string,
		MaterialName as string,
		RecordStatus as string,
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		RUSize as double,
		RackNlyteID as integer,
		OperationalStatus as string,
		LowerCabinetU as integer,
		AssetName as string,
		SerialNumber as string,
		RackName as string,
		NlyteID as integer,
		Model as string,
		MaterialSubtype as string,
		Tag as string,
		LastUpdateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		RFCodeTag,
		CreationDate,
		MaterialID,
		SiteName,
		DuplicateLocationGroupName,
		WFGrid,
		SiteGroup,
		MaterialType,
		LabPowerWatts,
		DataHall,
		ETLUser,
		Manufacturer,
		MaterialName,
		RecordStatus,
		UploadDate,
		RUSize,
		RackNlyteID,
		OperationalStatus,
		LowerCabinetU,
		AssetName,
		SerialNumber,
		RackName,
		NlyteID,
		Model,
		MaterialSubtype,
		Tag,
		LastUpdateDate),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
